objective.text: Set an exception type's reporting level without changing the response status.

difficulty.rationale: Set operational severity without altering the client’s failure semantics.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A plain RuntimeException must remain a normal server-error response but be logged at critical severity. Which exception configuration targets that requirement?

options.text: Set the channel’s minimum level to critical and leave the exception’s level unchanged.
options.rationale: A threshold can filter out an error-level record; it does not promote that record to critical.
options.misconception: A threshold can filter out an error-level record; it does not promote that record to critical.

options.rationale: The level mapping controls reporting severity; it does not rewrite the exception’s HTTP status.

options.text: Add RuntimeException to dontReport and rely on its 500 status to produce a critical log.
options.rationale: Reporting suppression prevents the ordinary log entry instead of changing its level.
options.misconception: Reporting suppression prevents the ordinary log entry instead of changing its level.

options.text: Return response("critical", 200) from its render callback.
options.rationale: That changes the client response to success rather than setting log severity.
options.misconception: That changes the client response to success rather than setting log severity.
